summary: A person belongs to a close circle and hears what it discusses. The noun covers both the company assembled and the counsel disclosed to trusted hearers.

senses.definition: Jacob sets council alongside assembly. Jeremiah describes a prophet who has stood in Yahweh’s council and heard his word.
Yahweh discloses his counsel to his prophets. Psalm 25 connects his confidence with making his covenant known to those who fear him.

parallels.note: Jacob sets the council and the assembly side by side.

note:
Psalm 25:14 can emphasize either intimate fellowship or the counsel communicated within it. The covenant made known in the second line supports the latter.

Root (2026-11-21): Filed under the hollow root סוד: Arabic سَاوَدْتُهُ 'I spoke secretly with him' is under s-w-d (Lane p. 1461), the confidential talk of Psa 25:14 and Pro 11:13. The niphal 'take counsel together' (Psa 2:2 נוֹסְדוּ, Psa 31:14 בְּהִוָּסְדָם), now in ysd.json, may belong here rather than to יסד 'found'.
